releases.synopsis: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

releases.title: Auto Battle Buddies
releases.synopsis: A cozy puppet-show auto battler where you accessorize your heroes with unique gear, build powerful teams, and battle other performers on the grand stage. Customize your puppets, climb the ranks, and create the ultimate Battle Buddies squad.

releases.title: Supermarket: Tidy Up!
releases.synopsis: Tidy up 4970 products your cat knocked off the shelves!

releases.title: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
releases.synopsis: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz is an online 1v1 multiplayer game in a PS1-inspired low-poly style. One player is a granny with a shotgun driving a fuel tanker across a bridge, fending off attacks with a smoke screen and an electronic jammer. The other player pilots an FPV kamikaze drone and tries to stop the tanker from reaching its destination. Players swap roles every round, while random weather and match modifiers change every run. The game supports keyboard and mouse, gamepads and real FPV radio controllers, and can also be played solo against bots.

releases.title: Voxmons
releases.synopsis:
Voxmons is a creature-collecting action RPG in which the collection does the fighting. Creatures hatched from eggs are equipped into a squad that orbits the player in rings, choosing its own targets and attacking while the player explores. The route runs across four worlds of floating islands - forest, snow, lava and graveyard - linked by bridges and sealed portals, each world ending in a boss, and each island holding its own hatch station with its own egg pool and its own published odds.

187 creatures are spread across seven rarities, each with rarer Large and Huge variants that hit harder and stand taller, and a permanent archive grants lasting bonuses for every species registered in it. Further systems open as the player advances: fusing duplicates into higher tiers, overclocking the rarest creatures, sending reserve creatures on timed expeditions, and leaving the squad to farm while the player is away. It is free to play, with no ads, no currency packs and one optional VIP membership. The artwork was created with generative AI; the game does not generate content with AI while it is played.

releases.title: Vizier
releases.synopsis: The king holds the power — but the words are yours. Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

releases.title: One More Lawn
releases.synopsis: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

releases.title: King Dies Rich
releases.synopsis: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

releases.title: Snow Worries!
releases.synopsis: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

releases.title: Dreadmiles
releases.synopsis: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

releases.title: Spin Tactics
releases.synopsis: Spin Tactics is a roguelike engine-builder set inside a slot machine. Each spin fills the board with coloured symbols, and connecting three or more of the same colour makes a combo. Gems change a symbol's colour, timing or effect for the rest of the run. More than 90 Companions can be equipped in eight slots, and their order matters, since some boost or copy the Companion next to them. Unwanted Companions, symbols and Gems can be sold in the Black Hole for gold. Each encounter has a score goal and a limited number of Actions, and bosses work against the player. Between runs, credits unlock Chips and Portals that change the starting hero. Runs take 30 to 60 minutes and end on an online leaderboard. There is no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

releases.title: Tidyspell
releases.synopsis: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

releases.title: Whiskers of Yesterday
releases.synopsis: You're a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

releases.title: All Eyes on Me
releases.synopsis: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

releases.title: Caramel Creek
releases.synopsis: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

releases.title: Terrahold
releases.synopsis:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

releases.title: Bottle Flip Inc
releases.synopsis: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

releases.title: Bar Owner Simulator
releases.synopsis: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

releases.title: Wizzy the Wood
releases.synopsis: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

releases.title: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
releases.synopsis: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

releases.title: Not My Dad
releases.synopsis: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

releases.title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
releases.synopsis: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Brewing the best drinks and retake the town... or, you know, kneecap the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

releases.title: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
releases.synopsis: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of new additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup.

releases.title: Fakin It XL
releases.synopsis: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

releases.title: PocoDoro
releases.synopsis: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives in a little handheld device on your desktop, next to whatever you're working on. Hatch a squishy slime, poke it, stretch it and throw it so it splats against the walls. Feed it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It grows up in real time, even while you're away.

releases.title: Get Rammed
releases.synopsis: Get Rammed is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

releases.title: The Lifeline
releases.synopsis: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

releases.title: The Miner's Routine
releases.synopsis: A cozy pixel-art game about a miner sent to a remote island by order of the King. Mine resources, restore an abandoned mine, upgrade your tools, hire workers, and venture deeper underground to discover what lies beneath the mountain.

releases.title: Tick & Tired
releases.synopsis: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

releases.title: Everyone's Tier List!
releases.synopsis: Everyone's Tier List! is an online party game for friends. Each round, players are given a theme and a set of words, and rank the words into tiers. Players then try to guess how the featured player ranked them. The game supports online multiplayer via Steam lobbies, a streamer mode, and custom word lists created by players.

releases.title: Undersea Post Office Sim
releases.synopsis: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

releases.title: Shadow Mist Idle
releases.synopsis: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

releases.title: Beyond The Blight
releases.synopsis: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

releases.title: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon
releases.synopsis: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?

releases.title: Procedure Zero
releases.synopsis: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information and take over the prison before they come for you.

releases.title: Carmilla: Crimson Moon
releases.synopsis: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

releases.title: Princessfall
releases.synopsis: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.
